prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Personalize & Sign Adoption Certificate", "Choose your companion's core personality traits before finalizing adoption.", "Select Temperament"]
1: ["Mastering Desktop Companion Controls", "Learn quick mouse gestures and keyboard shortcuts to interact with or dock your new pet.", "Right-click pet for instant menu; Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or hide."]
2: ["Voice Preview", "Idle Motion Preview"]
3: []
4: ["Sign in with your main email to ensure your companion state and memory are safely saved to the cloud."]
5: ["Creating Your Unique Desktop Pet...", "Synthesizing pet behaviors and desktop overlay shaders"]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready to Roam Your Screen!", "Your pet will gently sit on your taskbar and stay on top of active windows. You can move or minimize it anytime."]
7: ["Generation is running in the background. We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready."]
8: ["Includes Starter Accessory Pack"]
9: []

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or starter packs
